from datetime import datetime

# Retrieve cached hotel results
cached_hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")

# Retrieve cached restaurant results
cached_restaurants = get_results_from_cache(key="restaurants")

# Filter hotels for kid-friendly pool and breakfast included
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=cached_hotels,
    has_kids_club=True,
    breakfast_included=True
)

# Save filtered hotel results
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Filter restaurants for family-friendly options (vegetarian options as a proxy for family-friendly)
filtered_restaurants = filter_restaurants(
    prior_results=cached_restaurants,
    has_vegetarian_options=True
)

# Save filtered restaurant results
save_to_cache(key="filtered_restaurants", value=filtered_restaurants)

# Find nearest restaurants to the filtered hotels
nearest_results = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    restaurants=filtered_restaurants,
    groupBy="hotel"
)

# Save nearest results
save_to_cache(key="nearest_results", value=nearest_results)
